symbols.name: computed coefficient value
symbols.meaning: The computed Gaussian dyadic value that approximates the k-th coefficient w_k of W.
symbols.quote: Let $z_k$ be the computed value that holds $w_k$, the $k$-th coefficient of $W(t)=U(t)V(t)$.

symbols.name: exact product
symbols.meaning: The exact integer product of the two n-bit inputs.
symbols.quote: Let $Q$ be the exact product of the two $n$-bit inputs.

symbols.name: position count
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-2^b positions over which the carries are propagated, a count of positions.
symbols.quote: Let $M$ be the number of positions, with $M$ at least the number of coefficients and $bM\ge 2n$; positions past the last coefficient have $w_k=0$.

symbols.name: carry into a position
symbols.meaning: The carry added to the coefficient at position k, which is passed up from position k-1.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma_k$ be the carry into position $k$, with $\sigma_0=0$.

symbols.name: radix digit
symbols.meaning: The k-th radix-2^b digit of the exact product, an integer in {0,...,2^b-1}.
symbols.quote: At each position $k<M$, the digit is $e_k$, the remainder of $w_k+\sigma_k$ modulo $2^b$, and the carry is $\sigma_{k+1}=\lfloor (w_k+\sigma_k)/2^b\rfloor$, rounded down so that negative sums work.

relations.quote: Exact recovery by rounding and carries recovers the exact coefficients of a [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md), then turns them into the exact binary product by rounding and carrying.
Exact recovery rounds the values of the [Gaussian dyadic numbers](gaussian-dyadic.md) that hold the coefficients.
